public_payload.normalized_proposition: 80% of Anthropic's and OpenAI's revenues come from 1% of their customers, the vast majority of which are unprofitable AI startups, and the largest token purchasers, such as Perplexity, Cursor and Reflection AI, are all funded by NVIDIA.

statement.excerpt: 80% of Anthropic and OpenAI’s revenues come from 1% of their customers, the vast majority of which are unprofitable AI startups, with the largest purchasers of these tokens — like Perplexity, Cursor, and Reflection AI — all funded by NVIDIA.

from_speaker: the vast majority of which are unprofitable AI startups
the largest purchasers of these tokens
our_interpretation: The plain reading applies the concentration claim to total realized revenue and paying customers at each company.
A combined-company reading is also possible and should be checked separately if suitable data exist.
Use July–September 2026, the latest completed calendar quarter before publication, for revenue concentration, purchaser rankings and profitability.
The loss-making-startup qualifier refers to the top customer group. Venture backing alone does not establish losses.
Treat the named firms as examples of leading token purchasers, rather than an exact ranking of the three largest.
Earlier investment announcements can document financing history, but cannot establish target-quarter purchaser rankings or profitability.
No accounting basis is stated. The nearby reference to Ramp concerns growth, so it does not establish a basis for the whole concentration claim.
Vast majority and largest purchasers are qualifiers, not conditional antecedents.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable customer records establish approximately 80% of total realized revenue from the top 1% of paying customers, show that the overwhelming majority of that group are loss-making AI startups, and verify both the named firms' leading purchaser status and NVIDIA funding.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records materially reject the concentration figures, the claimed composition of the top customer group, or the asserted purchaser and financing relationships.
